# PROJECT SICLO1 — URDF SYNC CHANGE LOG
# Source URDF: Siclo1.urdf (autogenerated from Siclo1_temp.xacro)
# Applied: March 2026
# Modules touched: shared_state.py, stability.py, active_balance.py, HeartBeat.py
# Modules unchanged: recovery.py, perception.py

================================================================================
SECTION 1 — LINKAGE MAPPING  (shared_state.py  ::  DEFAULT_LINK_DATA)
================================================================================

How lengths were derived
─────────────────────────
The URDF uses a 3-DOF hip assembly (Twist → Inwards → Forwards) before the
thigh.  "Length" is the Euclidean magnitude of each joint-origin offset in the
full kinematic chain, accumulated from base_link to ankle with all joints at 0.

                  OLD (placeholder)     NEW (URDF-derived)
 l_thigh mass     5.000 kg              0.549828 kg   (Left_Upper_Leg_1)
 l_thigh length   0.500 m               0.060661 m   (Left_Hip_Forwards→Knee)
 l_shank mass     5.000 kg              0.250565 kg   (Left_Lower_Leg_1)
 l_shank length   0.500 m               0.686961 m   (Left_Knee→Ankle)
 r_thigh mass     5.000 kg              0.549828 kg   (Right_Upper_Leg_1)
 r_thigh length   0.500 m               0.107225 m   (Right_Hip_Fowards→Knee)
 r_shank mass     5.000 kg              0.250565 kg   (Right_Lower_Leg_1)
 r_shank length   0.500 m               0.759221 m   (Right_Knee→Ankle)
 l/r foot mass    (absent)              0.150000 kg   (Left/Right_Foot_1)
 torso mass       10.000 kg             5.999270 kg   (base_link)
 LoadConfig.base_mass  29.0 kg          8.100127 kg   (sum of all links)

com_local fractions derived from inertial <origin> z-offset / segment length:
 l_thigh  0.577   r_thigh  0.669
 l_shank  0.604   r_shank  0.652
 l/r foot 0.500   (foot COM at segment midpoint)

================================================================================
SECTION 2 — JOINT NAME ALIGNMENT  (all modules)
================================================================================

A URDF_JOINT_NAMES registry was added to shared_state.py.
All modules import keys from this dict — no bare string literals.

 Code key          Old string       New URDF string
 ─────────────     ──────────       ───────────────
 L_HIP_TWIST       (absent)         'Left_Hip_Twist'
 L_HIP_INWARDS     (absent)         'Left_Hip_Inwards'
 L_HIP_FORWARDS    'l_hip'          'Left_Hip_Forwards'
 L_KNEE            'l_knee'         'Left_Knee'
 L_ANKLE           'l_ankle'        'Left_Ankle'
 R_HIP_TWIST       (absent)         'Right_Hip_Twist'
 R_HIP_INWARDS     (absent)         'Right_Hip_Inwards'
 R_HIP_FORWARDS    'r_hip'          'Right_Hip_Fowards'   ← URDF typo preserved
 R_KNEE            'r_knee'         'Right_Knee'
 R_ANKLE           'r_ankle'        'Right_Ankle'

active_balance torque dict keys changed from
   {'l_ankle', 'r_ankle', 'l_hip', 'r_hip'}
to
   {'Left_Ankle', 'Right_Ankle', 'Left_Hip_Forwards', 'Right_Hip_Fowards'}
so apply_control() in HeartBeat.py can look them up directly by URDF name.

================================================================================
SECTION 3 — COORDINATE FRAME TRANSFORMATION  (stability.py)
================================================================================

URDF joint axis analysis:

 Joint              Axis xyz        Meaning
 ─────────────────  ─────────────   ─────────────────────────────────────
 Left_Hip_Forwards  -1  0  0        Negative X → positive θ = BACKWARD
 Left_Knee          -1  0  0        Same as above
 Right_Hip_Fowards  +1  0  0        Positive X → positive θ = FORWARD
 Right_Knee         +1  0  0        Same as above

The code convention (+X = forward) required the left-leg angles to be
negated before entering the sin/cos terms in forward_kinematics_2d().

CHANGE in stability.py :: forward_kinematics_2d():
   OLD:  np.sin(joint_angles['l_hip'])
   NEW:  th_l = -joint_angles[URDF_JOINT_NAMES['L_HIP_FORWARDS']]
         np.sin(th_l)                          ← sign flip on left side only

Right leg unchanged (axis +X already matches code convention).

Ankle axes are ≈ -Z (plantarflexion negative), consistent on both sides.
No ankle sign change required — active_balance torque sign convention
(negative torque = COM pushed left) is preserved.

================================================================================
SECTION 4 — INERTIA INTEGRATION  (active_balance.py :: _hip_strategy)
================================================================================

OLD formula (point-mass approximation):
    J_robot = BASE_ROBOT_MASS × h²   =  8.10 × 0.88²  ≈  6.28 kg·m²

NEW formula (URDF tensor):
    J_robot = J_TORSO_IYY             =  0.37776 kg·m²
              (base_link <inertia iyy="0.37776"/>)

Iyy is the sagittal-plane (pitch) inertia — physically correct for lateral
hip balance.  The old point-mass overestimated J_robot by 16×, which caused
the inertia_factor to under-scale hip torques when a load was present.

Load contribution unchanged structurally:
    J_load  = m_load × (h + LOAD_HEIGHT_ABOVE_COM)²

LOAD_HEIGHT_ABOVE_COM  changed:  0.20 m  →  0.10 m
    Reason: no separate backpack link in URDF.  Derived from:
    base_link inertial origin z (0.8806 m) + conservative offset (0.10 m).
    The load sits on the back of base_link, not 0.20 m above the torso COM.

NOMINAL_COM_HEIGHT  changed:  1.00 m  →  0.8806 m
    Source: base_link <inertial><origin xyz="... 0.8806..."/>

BASE_ROBOT_MASS  changed:  29.0 kg  →  8.100127 kg
    Source: sum of all URDF link masses.

FOOT_WIDTH  changed:  0.20 m  →  0.0286 m
    Source: Left ankle Y = 0.2250 m, Right ankle Y = 0.1964 m → Δ = 0.0286 m.
    This narrows the ankle-strategy threshold (FOOT_WIDTH / 4 = 0.00715 m).
    Consequence: the controller will escalate to HIP mode more readily
    because the support base is physically narrow.  Tune strategy_divisor
    in ActiveBalanceConfig if ankle-only mode is preferred for small errors.

================================================================================
SECTION 5 — LIMITS ENFORCEMENT  (HeartBeat.py)
================================================================================

New function added:
    _clip_to_urdf_limits(joint_name, limit_type, value) → float

Called in:
    PyBulletInterface.apply_control()        — clips torque effort
    PyBulletInterface.apply_position_control() — clips position + effort

All 10 actuated joints are covered.  Limits from Siclo1.urdf:

 Joint               effort  vel   lower (rad)   upper (rad)
 ──────────────────  ──────  ───   ───────────   ──────────
 Left_Hip_Twist       100    100   -0.349066      0.349066
 Left_Hip_Inwards     100    100   -0.698132      0.698132
 Left_Hip_Forwards    100    100   -1.570796      1.570796
 Left_Knee            100    100   -1.570796      1.570796
 Left_Ankle           100    100   -0.349066      0.349066
 Right_Hip_Twist      100    100   -0.034907      0.349066  ← asymmetric (URDF)
 Right_Hip_Inwards    100    100   -0.698132      0.698132
 Right_Hip_Fowards    100    100   -1.570796      1.570796
 Right_Knee           100    100   -1.570796      1.570796
 Right_Ankle          100    100   -0.349066      0.349066

NOTE: Right_Hip_Twist has an asymmetric range (-0.035 to +0.349 rad).
This appears intentional in the URDF — verify with mechanical design.

================================================================================
SECTION 6 — BUG FIX  (HeartBeat.py)
================================================================================

Pre-sync call:   active_balance.update_active_balance(dt=self.heartbeat.target_dt)
Fixed call:      active_balance.update_active_balance()

update_active_balance() accepts no arguments.  dt is read internally from
shared_state.last_dt (set by HeartbeatController.start_cycle()).
The old call raised a TypeError at runtime.

================================================================================
SECTION 7 — WHAT WAS NOT CHANGED
================================================================================

Per the brief, the following are UNTOUCHED:
  • 100 Hz heartbeat timing loop structure
  • FSM state machine (in gait_planner.py / recovery.py)
  • Capture Point mathematics (ω₀ = √(g/h), x_cp = x_com + ẋ/ω₀)
  • Cycloidal swing foot trajectory generator
  • Tuning parameters: FOOT_CLEARANCE_M, HIP_TORQUE_KP/KD,
    CONTACT_CONFIRM_WINDOW_S, kp_lateral, kd_lateral, torque limits
  • recovery.py — no URDF-sensitive constants
  • perception.py — no URDF-sensitive constants
